result.question: How has Tesla's total revenue changed over its last three fiscal years (2023 to 2025)?
result.answer: Tesla's total revenue over its last three fiscal years was as follows: $96,773 million in FY 2023 [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2023-12-31], $97,690 million in FY 2024 [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2024-12-31], and $94,827 million in FY 2025 [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2025-12-31]. Revenue rose modestly from 2023 to 2024, increasing by approximately $917 million (about 0.9%) [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2023-12-31] [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2024-12-31]. However, from 2024 to 2025, revenue declined by approximately $2,863 million (about 2.9%) [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2024-12-31] [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2025-12-31]. Overall, total revenue fell from $96,773 million in FY 2023 to $94,827 million in FY 2025, a net decrease of approximately $1,946 million [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2023-12-31] [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2025-12-31].
